title: Baked Lovely Chicken
description: A simple baked chicken recipe with lovely flavors. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix the lovely mustard, chinese five-spice seeds, salt, and pepper.
Apply the mustard mixture evenly to both sides of the chicken breast.
Place the chicken breast on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the chicken for 20-25 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is baking, slice the baked sweet potatoes into wedges.
Toss the sweet potato wedges with a little bit of oil and season with salt and pepper.
After the chicken has baked for 15 minutes, add the sweet potato wedges to the oven.
Continue baking for an additional 10-12 minutes or until the sweet potato wedges are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the chicken and sweet potato wedges from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
